title: 5G Broadcast (MBMS) Multimedia Broadcast / Multicast Service
short: A technology originally introduced in LTE (eMBMS) that enables efficient transmission of the same content to a large number of users at once — that is, broadcast or multicast instead of individual unicast. In 5G, its evolution is used for the so‑called LTE‑based 5G Terrestrial Broadcast.
desc: **It is a technology originally introduced in LTE (eMBMS) that enables efficient transmission of the same content to a large number of users at once** — that is, broadcast or multicast instead of individual unicast.
